abstract: This paper examines how far-right political actors employed AI-generated multimedia content in their digital campaigning during the 2024 European Parliament elections. Focusing on the platforms Instagram and X, it analyses the intersection of populist communication strategies and generative artificial intelligence. The study situates AI-produced imagery and media within broader patterns of far-right online mobilization and messaging.
key_claims: Far-right actors integrated AI-generated multimedia content into their digital campaigns during the 2024 European elections.
The convergence of populist communication styles and generative AI represents a notable development in political campaigning.
Platform affordances of Instagram and X shape how AI-generated content is deployed for far-right messaging.
methods: Analysis of digital campaign content on Instagram and X during the 2024 European Parliament elections.
Examination of AI-generated multimedia content in the context of far-right political communication.
findings: Specific empirical findings are not available from the abstract alone.
contributions: Advances understanding of how generative AI tools are being used in populist and far-right political campaigning.
Provides a cross-platform (Instagram and X) perspective on AI-driven electoral communication in the European context.
framing: The paper is positioned within scholarship on populism, far-right digital communication, and the emerging role of generative artificial intelligence in political campaigning, using the 2024 European elections as a case study.
